label: E

handoff.what: Launch a recurring match-day social media series across her channels for each remaining Stanford women's soccer fixture of the season.
handoff.why: Stanford's soccer season is underway, and establishing a consistent match-day series will capitalize on her strong audience engagement. With the next matches scheduled (Syracuse on Oct 8 and Cal on Oct 16), a recurring campaign through the end of the season will satisfy her athletic narrative.

parsed.rationale: The requested move is a season-long, recurring activation spanning all remaining Stanford women's soccer fixtures. Because it operates as a persistent content initiative with an aggregate objective (season-long match-day presence) and a clear external end point tied to the athletic season's horizon, it represents a campaign. Per constraints, campaign-level work requires formal initiation by the athlete rather than tactical planning. Additionally, the lack of visibility into travel-match content support (notSeen) requires a campaign-level operational plan to resolve resource availability before individual assets can be scoped.

dependencies.why: Defines the strategic intent of a season-long match-day series and its end-of-season horizon.

completion.planning_complete_when: The campaign is formally established and a campaign charter defining resource constraints, travel-match content support, and creative bounds is approved by the athlete.
completion.does_not_imply: That the match-day series has launched, that individual match assets have been produced, or that audience engagement goals have been realized.

escalation.why: The recommended match-day series constitutes a multi-month, recurring activation linked directly to the Stanford women's soccer fixtures, requiring an ongoing operational framework (especially for travel matches) and ending specifically with the season's conclusion.
